acceptanceEvidence: src/app/globals.css defines the type scale (--text-display/h2/h3/lede/eyebrow/price with line height, spacing, weight), --color-hairline, --color-tint, --shadow-raise (evergreen-tinted light, black dark), the cut-corner-sm/md/photo and cut-band utilities (clip-path removed on :focus-visible and :has(:focus-visible)), highlight, signature-rise/lift with reduced-motion overrides; palette unchanged (asserted in tests/theme-contrast.test.ts).

tests/theme-contrast.test.ts keeps the existing AA pair list (ink on ivory, muted on ivory/white, evergreen on fresh, white on evergreen, ivory on night, dark muted, success, danger, warning, both button pairs) and adds the tint panel, highlight, band and sage pairs in light and dark plus token and focus-exception checks.

fields-public.ts registers home.hero.highlight and nine home.check/ticket items with starting wording; template-contract.ts has the matching slots and CONTRACT_FINGERPRINT 25c8de38; SITE_TEMPLATE_VERSION signature-1; tests/vc5-template-contract.test.ts and tests/public-pages-render.test.tsx (every editable item renders, no stray words) pass; tests/public-copy-from-settings.test.ts scans public pages for the old hard-coded sentences.

src/app/(public)/page.tsx composes both variants (eyebrow with first city, display heading with optional highlight via splitHighlight, lede, address check or the usual button, cut-frame photo over offset tint with floating price ticket from the first published set price, hairline ledger, featured set card, CSS-counter steps, band, two-column FAQ, closing call); tests/public-pages-render.test.tsx snapshots and checks both variants.

service-area-check.ts is the pure SERVED/NOT_YET/INVALID rule (tests/service-area-check.test.ts); check-address-actions.ts applies the shared limiter, a honeypot and stores or logs nothing (tests/check-address-action.test.ts); the contact page and form prefill address and ZIP from the link only (page render tests); wording comes from website content.

e2e/signature-home.spec.ts (registered in e2e/shards.json) runs axe at 360/768/1440 in light and dark, checks for sideways scrolling, one cut control keeps a complete focus ring, and reduced motion removes the entrance animation; runs in exact-head CI.
